title: Participants
testPlayerOptionHelp: A made-up player to try the registration. She signs in with the fixed code of the test environment and can be deleted completely.
testPlayerForcedHelp: With your access you create test players only.
testPlayerDeleteHint: A test player is deleted completely, and you can then create her again with the same address.
testPlayerDeleteBody: Everything is deleted: the account, the profile, the answers, the consents, the signatures and the files. This cannot be undone.
testPlayerDeleteFailed: The test player could not be deleted. Try again.
searchHint: Search does not cover the encrypted fields (document, phone, address).
emptyBody: Try fewer filters or a different search.
loadFailed: We could not load the list.
detailNotFoundTitle: We could not find this participant
detailNotFoundBody: The link may be an old one, or this record may not belong to your organisation.
accessLogged: Every look at this record is logged with your name and the date.
forumPostingStatusChangeFailed: Forum posting access could not be changed.
statusChangeFailed: We could not change the status. Try again.
notesEmpty: There are no notes about this participant yet.
notesAppendOnly: Notes cannot be edited or deleted: they are the record of what the team knew, and when.
noteAddPlaceholder: What is worth remembering from this conversation?
noteRequired: Write something before adding the note.
noteTooLong: The note is too long (at most {{count}} characters).
noteAddFailed: We could not add the note. Try again.
activityEmpty: There is nothing in this section yet.
activityIntro: This section fills up as the participant takes part in the programme.
mediaConsentGranted: Appears in community photos and stories.
mediaConsentDenied: Does not appear in photos or stories.
entityPrefillHint: It will appear pre-filled in her guided registration, and she can change it.
inviteIntro: Record the invitation and tell her to open the app and enter her email. She will get a 6-digit code by email, no password.
inviteFailed: We could not create the invitation. Try again.
invitedBody: When {{email}} opens the app with her email, her guided registration will show the entity pre-filled.
invitesEmpty: No invitation has been sent yet.
rgpdSectionHint: Two actions that cannot be undone. To take her off the lists for now, use Deactivate above.
rgpdOpenRequest: She has asked for her data to be deleted.
eraseAdminOnly: Only an admin can erase a record completely.
anonymizeConfirmBody: The record stays for reporting, but stops saying who she is.
anonymizeConsequenceRemoved: Her name, papers, phone, address and photo are deleted.
anonymizeConsequenceKept: Nationality, birth year, town and referring entity stay.
anonymizeConsequenceNotes: Every staff note about her is deleted.
anonymizeConsequenceConsent: Permission to use her photos is withdrawn.
eraseConfirmBody: Nothing will be left. There is no way to get it back.
eraseConsequenceRecord: Her record and everything attached to it are deleted.
eraseConsequenceMedia: The photos and files she uploaded are deleted.
eraseConsequenceAccess: She loses access to the app immediately.
eraseConsequenceAudit: A record of who did this and when is kept, with none of her data.
eraseFulfillsRequest: This answers the request she made herself:
deletionRequestsHint: Requests participants made from their own profile.
equipmentAppendOnly: Every handover is recorded with who did it and when. It cannot be deleted: if something is wrong, record the correct entry below it.
equipmentEmpty: Nothing has been handed to her yet.
equipmentAddFailed: We could not record the handover.
inviteNoEmailHint: If she has no email, help her create one first (for example a Gmail account), then invite her with that address.
inviteAlreadyHasAccount: This email already has an account. Find her in the participant list.
invitedReferralNote: The entity's referral will be linked to her profile when she finishes registration.
selectParticipant: Choose a participant to see her card.

material.chooseItem: Choose the item and the size.
material.signatureHint: She signs with her finger. If she does not sign, choose why below.
material.signatureRequired: She signs, or choose why she does not and write the reason.
material.savedUnitCode: Unit code {{code}}. Write it on the item.
material.savedOffline: Saved on this phone. It goes out when you are online.
material.savedBelowZero: Stock for this item is now below zero. Today asks for a count.
material.rejected: Not saved. Try again or remove it.
material.returnFailed: The return was not saved. Check the connection and try again.
material.saveFailed: The handover was not saved. Try again.

valueLabel.purchase: Price of one item in euros
valueLabel.sponsor: Value of one item in euros

arrival.valueHint: The item's usual value is filled in. Change it if this one is different.
arrival.photosHint: A photo of the goods, and one of the delivery note or receipt.
arrival.photoFailed: The photo was not uploaded. Try again.
arrival.cameraDenied: Allow the camera in Settings to take a photo.
arrival.needsConnection: Recording goods received needs a connection.
arrival.saveFailed: The arrival was not saved. Try again.

count.title: Count {{item}}
count.intro: Count what is on the shelf, size by size. The app shows its own numbers only after you count.
count.matches: The count matches the stock. Nothing changes.
count.difference: {{size}}: the stock says {{expected}}, the shelf has {{counted}}
count.differenceNoSize: The stock says {{expected}}, the shelf has {{counted}}
count.reasonRequired: Choose why the count is different.
count.saveFailed: The count was not saved. Try again.
count.monthlyItem: {{item}}: count what is on the shelf.

checkout.action: Check out to a staff member
checkout.title: Check out material
checkout.intro: For a trip or an event. Material for a normal session is not recorded.
checkout.saveFailed: The checkout was not saved. Try again.
checkout.chooseAll: Choose the item, the size and who takes it.
checkout.missing: Missing: {{count}}. They stay out of stock as lost.
checkout.checkInFailed: The check-in was not saved. Try again.

items.title: Items
items.intro: The material the team hands out, counts and receives.
items.builtin: Built-in item. Its name comes from the app's translations.
items.nameRequired: Write at least the Catalan name.
items.kindHint: Player kit is handed to players and gets unit codes. Team equipment is counted.
items.sizesHint: Leave empty for an item without sizes. A size that still has stock cannot be removed.
items.valueLabel: Usual value of one piece in euros
items.valueHint: Filled in on every donation of this item.
items.codeHint: One to three letters for unit codes, for example AV for AV-0001.
items.activeHint: A switched-off item leaves the lists and keeps its history.
items.saveFailed: The item was not saved. Try again.
items.sizeInStock: Size {{size}} still has stock. Count it to zero or keep it.
items.codeTaken: Another item already uses these code letters.

profile.saveFailed: We could not save the record. Try again.
profile.deactivateBody: She leaves the active lists and keeps her record. You can reactivate her later.
profile.sensitiveHidden: You do not see the document number, phone, address or postal code. They stay as they are.
profile.notesLoadFailed: We could not load the notes.

activity.loadFailed: We could not load the activity.

invites.cancelBody: She can no longer sign in with this address. You can invite her again later.
invites.actionFailed: We could not change the invitation. Try again.
invites.loadFailed: We could not load the invitations.

inviteNameError: Enter her first and last name.
invitedCompleteHint: We created her profile. Now fill in what you already know about her: the guided sign-up will only ask her the rest.
questionStatesFailed: The questions could not be saved. Try again.
questionStatesRequiredHint: Required: answer it before you take it out of the registration.
authorizationNone: She has not signed an authorization yet.
authorizationUnableToDraw: She signed with the boxes only: she could not draw her signature.
authorizationPaperFailed: It could not be recorded. Try again.
seasonNoCurrent: There is no current season yet. Create it in Settings, Authorization.
reminderIntro: Pending players get a notification in the app to sign the new season.
reminderAction: Send a reminder to the {{count}} pending
reminderNobody: None of the pending players has the app with notifications on.
reminderFailed: The reminder could not be sent. Try again.
reminderNotificationBody: Open the app to check your details and sign the authorization for the {{season}} season.

signing.title: Collect signatures
signing.intro: Hand the tablet to a player so she signs the season's authorization. Pick a player who is already in Ramassà, or write the name of a new woman.
signing.pending: {{count}} signatures are waiting to be sent
signing.pending_one: 1 signature is waiting to be sent
signing.pendingHint: They are saved encrypted on this tablet and are sent by themselves when there is a connection.
signing.refused: The server did not accept {{name}}'s signature.
signing.loadFailed: The authorization could not be loaded. Connect the tablet once to save it.
signing.nothingPublished: No authorization is published for the current season.
signing.needsDeviceLock: Turn on a passcode, fingerprint or Face ID on this tablet. Leaving signing mode asks you to confirm it is you.
signing.rosterOffline: The list needs a connection. A new woman can sign with no connection.
signing.walkInHint: She becomes a participant only after the team confirms her signing on the dashboard.
signing.guidedAccessHint: For more safety, also turn on Guided Access (iPad) or screen pinning (Android).
signing.signOutBody: They stay encrypted on this tablet and are sent when you sign in here again. If you have a connection, wait until they are sent before you sign out.
signing.lockForced: The app locks while {{count}} signatures wait to be sent, even with the lock turned off.
signing.lockForced_one: The app locks while 1 signature waits to be sent, even with the lock turned off.

walkIns.title: Women who signed on a tablet
walkIns.intro: They signed the authorization on a team tablet before they were in Ramassà. They are not participants until you confirm them or merge them into a player.
walkIns.discardConfirm: Discard this signature? This cannot be undone.
walkIns.failed: That did not work. Try again.

questionStatesSavePreset: Save these choices as a preset
questionStatesPresetFailed: The preset could not be saved.
inviteReviewAction: Next: what she will be asked
inviteQuestionsTitle: What she will be asked when she opens the app
inviteQuestionsSummary: She will be asked {{asked}} of {{total}} questions.
inviteQuestionAskedWhenItApplies: Asked when it applies to her
testScenarioIntro: Set her situation, then open the app as her. The app shows it the next time it opens.
testScenarioTermsAccepted: Accepted: she has joined and skips the onboarding.
testScenarioTermsNot: Not accepted: she goes through the onboarding.
testScenarioSeasonNot: Not signed: the app asks her to sign.
testScenarioNoSeason: There is no current season. Create one in Registration first.
testScenarioReturning: Returning: she signed an earlier season, so the app shows re-registration.
testScenarioNew: New: she has no earlier season.
testScenarioAnswersIntro: A filled question gets a sample answer in her language, as if staff had entered it, so the onboarding does not ask it.
testScenarioResetHint: Back to a brand-new player: nothing answered but her name, terms not accepted, nothing signed. Her account and email stay.
testScenarioNeedsRequiredAnswers: Fill her required answers first. She can only join with them.
testScenarioJoinedKeepsRequired: She has joined, so her required answers stay. Mark the terms as not accepted first.
testScenarioFailed: The change was not saved. Try again.
testScenarioCustomIntro: Fill them with a valid test answer of each type, or clear them. A test file has no content behind it.
testScenarioDraftTerms: Her phone shows the draft of the app terms. When it is published or discarded, the test acceptances of this draft are deleted.
testScenarioDraftAuthorization: Her phone shows the draft of the season authorization. When it is published or discarded, the test signatures of this draft are deleted.
inviteScreenRequired: It has a required question nobody answered.
